better_overall.reason: A is the more polished and more legible page for 70-year-olds on phones, with a review step that shows the phone number grouped as 138 1234 5678, a clear success page, and separate sign-ups for family members sharing one phone. B has the more distinctive calligraphy touches and is more upfront about missing details, but its typesetting is rougher and two people sharing one phone would overwrite each other's sign-up.

post_code_notes: Stage-1 verdicts stand. The code adds to B's distinctiveness: when a class is chosen, a hand-drawn red circle (like a teacher's mark on practice paper) is drawn around the 楷/行 grid tile, and the same marked tile appears on the confirmation page. The code also explains the visual gap: A uses text-wrap balance/pretty and non-breaking spaces between digits and words to stop single characters falling onto a new line; B has neither, hence its orphaned 字/书. A's brush title is only the system 楷体 font with wide letter-spacing, and its seal and swoosh are CSS/SVG. Flows: A is fill, then a review page, then confirm, then a success page (green tick, 'name, 您已报名…', a next-steps box saying the school will phone, a '再帮别人报名' button). It shows specific errors in large type beside each field ('您填了 10 位') and moves focus to the first one. It also handles the phone's back button, accepts full-width digits and +86, works without JavaScript, and has a password-protected roster page with CSV export. B is a single page: class, name, phone, submit. It shows a linked error summary plus inline errors, announces status for screen readers, supports high-contrast and forced-colours modes, offers '修改报名信息' after submitting (the old entry is replaced using an edit key), and writes a CSV on every sign-up. One weakness in B: it treats the same phone number in the same class as the same person and replaces the name, so a couple sharing one phone loses one sign-up; A keys on name plus phone and explicitly allows several people per phone. Honesty: neither invents a place, date, teacher or contact number. A hides its empty location and contact settings but promises a phone call and gives a specific curriculum line ('从握笔和基本笔画学起'), and it says '报名成功' while also saying the school will call to confirm. B says on the main page that the school will send the location, start date and payment details, and words the result more carefully ('报名已提交').
